texte.Das Mikrofon ist erlaubt. Nach Neustarts: The microphone is allowed. After restarts a dialog can hold up the display. “Set up” switches it off.
texte.Das Tablet lädt nicht. Netzteil und Kabe: The tablet is not charging. Check the power adapter and cable.
texte.Der Bildschirm geht von selbst aus. „Ein: The screen switches off by itself. “Set up” changes this.
texte.Der Sperrbildschirm ist aktiv. Das Table: The lock screen is active. After a restart the tablet only starts after a swipe. Android: Settings → Security → Screen lock → None.
texte.Der Sperrbildschirm muss aus sein, sonst: The lock screen must be off, otherwise the display only starts after a swipe following a restart. Android: Settings → Security → Screen lock → None. Fire tablets: passcode off; only ADB can switch off the swipe lock screen (see the guide).
texte.Die Fernsteuerung von Fully ist nicht er: Fully’s remote control is not reachable. Are the address and password right, “Remote Administration” on, and can server and tablet reach each other?
texte.Die Ladegrenze meldet einen Fehler: die: The charge limit reports an error: the smart plug is not reachable. Check the plug and the Wi-Fi.
texte.Die Start-Adresse im Tablet gehört zu di: The start address in the tablet belongs to this frame.
texte.Die Start-Adresse im Tablet passt nicht: The start address in the tablet does not match this frame. “Set up” fixes it.
texte.Fully läuft ohne Plus-Lizenz. Dann gehen: Fully runs without a Plus licence. Night mode and battery reports then do not work.
texte.Kein Zugriff auf Fully. Trage unten Adre: No access to Fully. Enter the address and password below and Frameside will also check the tablet’s settings.
texte.Keine Ladegrenze eingerichtet. Die Frame: No charge limit set up. The Frameside Android app can keep the battery within a range using a Shelly plug.
texte.Mikrofon aus: nach Neustarts kommt kein: Microphone off: no dialog after restarts.
texte.Startet nach Neustart und Stromausfall v: Starts by itself after a restart and after a power cut.
texte.Startet nach einem Neustart nicht von se: Does not start by itself after a restart. “Set up” changes this.
texte.Zum Schluss einmal neu starten: Die Dias: Finally restart once: the slideshow must come up without any touch and without a dialog.
texte.Benutzer für den Kalender (nur wenn er g: User for the calendar (only if it is protected)
texte.Zum Beispiel für Radicale oder Nextcloud: For example for Radicale or Nextcloud: the calendar’s address plus user and password. The password is stored on the server only and never shown again.
texte.Wenn heute nichts mehr ansteht: Termine: If nothing is left today: show appointments up to … days ahead (0 = today only, 1 = also tomorrow)
Applies to appointments from the calendar link. The frame first shows what is still due today; if there is nothing, the next day with appointments within these days.
Simple access for one person (e.g. grandma)
texte.Die Person bekommt einen Link (oder QR-C: The person gets a link (or QR code) to a very simple page with big buttons: add photos, make their own shows and show them on this frame. The photos go into their own Immich account. They cannot see or change anything else in the app, and nothing is deleted.
E-mail and password go to Immich only. What is stored is a key of its own, revocable in Immich and without delete rights – not the password.
texte.Adresse, unter der die Person den Server: Address under which the person reaches the server
texte.Diesen Zugang widerrufen? Der Link funkt: Revoke this access? The link will stop working. The Immich account and the photos are kept.
texte.Den Link findest du oben unter „Link und: You find the link above under “Show link and QR code”.
texte.Neue Fotos kommen in dein Konto. Gelösch: New photos go into your account. Nothing is deleted here.
texte.Diese Fotos jetzt auf dem Rahmen zeigen: Show these photos on the frame now
texte.Tippe die Fotos an, die in der Show sein: Tap the photos that should be in the show.
texte.Name der Show, z. B. Urlaub 2026: Name of the show, e.g. Holiday 2026
texte.Du hast noch keine Show gespeichert. Mit: You have not saved a show yet. “Make a new show” lets you create one.
texte.Dieser Link gilt nicht mehr: This link is no longer valid
Please ask for a new link.
texte.Für dich ist noch kein Rahmen eingericht: No frame has been set up for you yet.
texte.Dein Rahmen ist gerade aus oder nicht im: Your frame is off or not online right now. That is fine: the photos still arrive.
texte.Noch keine Fotos. Füge zuerst Fotos hinz: No photos yet. Add some photos first.
texte.✓ Gespeichert. Die Show läuft gleich auf: ✓ Saved. The show will start on your frame in a moment.
texte.✓ Die Fotos laufen gleich auf deinem Rah: ✓ The photos will start on your frame in a moment.
texte.✓ Die Show läuft gleich auf deinem Rahme: ✓ The show will start on your frame in a moment.
texte.Diese Show löschen? Die Fotos bleiben er: Delete this show? The photos are kept.
texte.✓ Der Rahmen zeigt wieder sein normales: ✓ The frame is showing its normal programme again.
texte.Standard zeigt nur den einfachen Weg mit: Standard shows only the simple way with the app. Expert also shows Fully, ADB and the manual routes.
The Frameside app is up to date.
texte.Es gibt eine neuere Frameside-App. Lade: There is a newer Frameside app. Download it again from GitHub (Add device → Install app) and install it over the old one.
texte.Das Tablet ist von selbst wieder da. Die: The tablet came back by itself. The display runs without any touch.
texte.Nach 15 Minuten ist das Tablet nicht zur: The tablet did not come back after 15 minutes. Check the lock screen, “Display over other apps” and Wi-Fi.
texte.Das Tablet ist aus. Frameside wartet, bi: The tablet is off. Frameside is waiting for it to come back by itself …
texte.Starte das Tablet jetzt neu (ausschalten: Restart the tablet now (switch it off and on again) and do not touch it afterwards. Frameside is waiting …
The slideshow is running: the picture changes.
texte.Das Bild wechselt nicht mehr, die Anzeig: The picture no longer changes, the display seems stuck. “Reload page” or “Restart display” usually helps.
texte.Der Sperrbildschirm muss aus sein, sonst: The lock screen must be off, otherwise the display only starts after a swipe following a restart. Android: Settings → Security → Screen lock → None.
The diagnosis is in the clipboard. Paste it into a message.
texte.Das Kopieren ging nicht. Prüfe das Table: Copying did not work. Run the tablet check and select the lines by hand.
texte.Küche: Uhrzeit und Datum im Bild: Kitchen: time and date in the picture
texte.Für eine ältere Person: Datum und Uhrzei: For an older person: date and time, appointments for 3 days
texte.Noch keine Wechsel aufgezeichnet. Frames: No changes recorded yet. From now on Frameside remembers when the tablet gets or loses power.
texte.Bei WLAN-Ausfall zeigt das Tablet bis zu: If the Wi-Fi fails, the tablet keeps showing up to 150 photos it has already seen (HTTPS is active).
texte.Ohne HTTPS (https://) hält das Tablet ke: Without HTTPS (https://) the tablet keeps no photo reserve: if the Wi-Fi fails, the slideshow does not continue with stored photos.
texte.Steht das Tablet außerhalb deines Heimne: If the tablet is outside your home network, enter this address in the app:
texte.Diese App-Version kann sich noch nicht s: This app version cannot update itself yet: update it by hand once, after that it works with a button.
texte.Prüft, ob das Tablet für den Dauerbetrie: Checks whether the tablet is ready for round-the-clock use as a frame (read-only, nothing is changed).
texte.Für die Einstellungen von Fully brauchst: For the Fully settings you need the address and password below; without them the check only shows what the device reports to the server.
texte.Speichert Einstellungen, Geräte und geme: Saves settings, devices and remembered shows in one file. With it you restore everything after a reinstall or a move.
texte.Die Datei enthält dann Geheimnisse: gut: The file then contains secrets: keep it safe, do not pass it on.
texte.Das ist keine Frameside-Sicherung: This is not a Frameside backup
